summary.what_it_does: The page is a prompt gallery for Google's Nano Banana 2.1 image generation and editing model, with prompts sourced from creators' X posts and each shown next to its output. It highlights a few top prompts in full, including a structured JSON photo-reconstruction spec, a full-body geometric fashion illustration, and a split photo-and-ink-illustration poster template. It also summarizes model specs as stated on the page: 1K, 2K or 4K output, extra aspect ratios, up to 14 reference images, and API per-image prices. A section offers tips from Google's guide on describing scenes and stating intent.
notable: Each prompt is paired with its output image and linked to the creator's post
Includes a structured JSON prompt format for detailed photo reconstruction
Lists Nano Banana 2.1 API pricing per image size, with half price via Batch API
Page states some Try links are affiliate links
caveats: Page states Try links are affiliate links, and AgentCraft earns commission on subscriptions made through them
Prompt library is described as free, but the page does not state pricing for the library itself beyond the free listing note
API costs are listed in dollars per image and are specific to the API, not the consumer app
